process.title: How it works
process.lead: Six steps from first conversation to regular reporting.

steps.title: Consultation & Capital
steps.text: Goals and capital are confirmed. Capital sets the fleet size.

steps.title: Truck Selection
steps.text: We agree the mix (dry box, chiller, van or heavy duty) to match live partner demand.

steps.title: Purchase & Registration
steps.text: Upsworth sources, buys and registers the trucks. You keep ownership.

steps.title: Partner Matching
steps.text: Each truck is allocated to a vetted logistics partner under a documented operating agreement.

steps.title: Operations & Tracking
steps.text: Trucks run contracted routes. Trips, utilization, maintenance and insurance are tracked.

steps.title: Reporting & Income
steps.text: Regular reports on income, costs and net distribution.

portfolio.title: Portfolio management
portfolio.lead: Six areas we manage for your fleet.

items.title: Asset Control
items.text: Ownership records, registration, insurance and specs.

items.title: Partner Agreements
items.text: Allocation, rates, payment cycle and responsibilities.

items.title: Utilization Tracking
items.text: Trip records, GPS tracking where available, and downtime.

items.title: Maintenance Discipline
items.text: Preventive schedules and an agreed reserve policy.

items.title: Monthly Reporting
items.text: Fleet income, costs, net distribution and notes.

items.title: Scale Decisions
items.text: Distribute, reinvest or add trucks based on performance.

earns.title: How each truck earns
earns.lead: Income follows the work the truck actually does.

logistics.disclaimer: Income is activity based: higher utilization can improve it, while downtime, repairs or weak routes can reduce it. Returns are not fixed or guaranteed.
